in_marathi.name: Parvinder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parvinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parvatindra, Parvat means mountain and Indra means lord. The name Parvinder is derived from Lord Shiva, who is known to be the king of mountains and the god of destruction.
